issues.description: The problem statement and the solution expect a function named build_msd_circ(...), but the template repository defines the function as build_msd_circuit(...). This identifier mismatch will prevent students from implementing the expected function name and will cause tests or references (which call build_msd_circ) to fail or be confusing.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function build_msd_circuit to build_msd_circ to match the problem statement and solution, or add a thin compatibility wrapper in the template: def build_msd_circ(circ, distilled_state, y_states): return build_msd_circuit(circ, distilled_state, y_states). Ensure docstring and tests reference use the same name.
